description: This course broadly covers quantitative trading, focusing on strategies built through time-series analysis. Techniques for identifying trading opportunities by sifting through historical data will be explored. The course also addresses the quantification of risk associated with potential trading decisions.
prerequisite: If undertaking an Undergraduate DegreeTHEN( must have completed BT2101 at a grade of at least D)
prerequisiteRule: PROGRAM_TYPES IF_IN Undergraduate Degree THEN (COURSES (1) BT2101:D)
title: Analytics for Capital Market Trading and Investment
